messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Leadership | Mining, Energy, ESG and Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Khara,

Your current Saudi Arabia work across executive search, strategic partnerships, market entry, energy and infrastructure makes this a focused introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and cross-functional country-facing delivery within a major gold-mining operation.

Across 12+ years, my experience spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My current role sits where executive leadership, ministries, regulators, communities, investment priorities, energy transition and complex industrial operations intersect.

Saudi Arabia is my first international priority. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across mining, energy, natural resources, infrastructure and industrial development. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Given your work connecting international leaders with Saudi organisations and sovereign-backed growth initiatives, I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming leadership searches aligned with this profile. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
